# Cressida Lindsay

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- **Origin:** Harborough, Nova Scotia  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Cressy  <sub>[v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Cressida possesses a striking, captivating beauty with satiny, brown-nut-colored hair and dark, plush eyes set beneath angled black eyebrows. She has plump, warm cheeks, uneven red lips, and a high sense of style, often wearing fashionable clothing such as a brown suit with golden-brown poppies on her straw headwear.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P20](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0020)_

## Personality

Cressida is energetic, charming, affectionate, and completely free from snobbery, though she admits to being highly indecisive and unable to keep secrets. She enjoys social life, jamborees, and having numerous male suitors and companions, whom she regards warmly as friends. Describing herself as far less foolish than she outwardly appears, she possesses sharp intellect despite her playful and talkative nature.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P26](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0026), [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c4 P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036), [v3 c4 P62](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0062), [v3 c4 P71](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0071), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c21 P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000)_

## Traits

- Indecisive  <sub>[v3 c4 P26](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0026)</sub>
- Incapable of keeping secrets  <sub>[v3 c4 P36](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0036)</sub>
- Loves football  <sub>[v3 c6 P6](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0006)</sub>

## Abilities

- Sharp intellect and high academic ability  <sub>[v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003)</sub>

## Goals

- To be well-liked and surrounded by friends and companions  <sub>[v3 c4 P71](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0071), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003)</sub>

## History

Cressida met Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis in a cemetery while attending Wexcombe College as a Freshman. She quickly bonded with them and introduced them into her wide, elite social circle. As the daughter of a prominent family, she enjoyed immense popularity at college, attracting the romantic interest of numerous male suitors, including Hector and Orlando, while maintaining correspondence with her friends. During a college break, she hosted Nell for two weeks at her family estate, Mount Holly in Harborough, taking her on excursions and guiding her to her childhood home.

_Sources: [v3 c4 P19](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0019), [v3 c4 P28](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0028), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 c5 P3](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0003), [v3 c6 P6](../source/v03-c06.md#nw-v03-c06-p0006), [v3 c21 P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000), [v3 c21 P4](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0004)_

## Background by volume

- Daughter of a wealthy and prominent man from an elite 'Bluenose' lineage in Harborough  <sub>[v3 c4 P32](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0032), [v3 c4 P34](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0034), [v3 c5 P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002)</sub>
- Resides at Mount Holly, her historic family estate in Harborough  <sub>[v3 c21 P0](../source/v03-c21.md#nw-v03-c21-p0000)</sub>
